description: This file contains utility classes and functions related to Snowflake integration within a larger language model project. It defines exception handling, configuration management, parameter mapping, environment validation, and API endpoint setup for Snowflake AI endpoints.

classes.name: SnowflakeException
classes.description: A custom exception class for Snowflake AI Endpoints errors, inheriting from BaseLLMException.

classes.name: SnowflakeBaseConfig
classes.description: Configuration class providing methods to support, map parameters, validate environment, and set API endpoints for Snowflake integration.

methods.name: List[str] get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI-like parameters for the specified model.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps non-default parameters into optional parameters if they are supported by the specified model.

methods.name: _get_api_base(self, api_base, optional_params)
methods.description: Constructs and returns the API base URL for Snowflake, appending '/api/v2' if necessary.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Prepares and returns headers for Snowflake API requests, validating the presence of necessary credentials and setting authorization headers.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] _get_openai_compatible_provider_info( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Retrieves the API base URL and API key, defaulting to secrets if not provided.
